scope: Offline trace analysis; no new model calls, runtime changes or paid grading.
measurement_notes: Logical MCP payload serialized once with json.dumps, ensure_ascii=False. These character counts are proxies, not model input tokens. Host serialization is not observed.
Structured/text duplicate representations are not counted twice. Whether the host feeds both representations to the model is unknown.
Native output measured from aggregated_output. Formatting differs from MCP JSON; character totals are not directly equivalent token counts.
Returned source-location overlap is deduplicated within each call, then counted as repeated when delivered again in another call. It does not prove repeated model use.
Turn-level traces do not expose per-model-request input usage or full model requests; exact causal attribution to schemas, results and round trips is unavailable.
Tool operations can run in parallel or batch; operation count is not a count of model requests.
